Add a ctrl+q toggle for the notes pane
Queued replies must be editable before sending
Fix the flicker when the selection pane opens
Please write docs next to the plugin docs
the tasks should be kept in the md file
Use the captain's status names everywhere
Rename the panel to Todo
ctrl+q does not open the pane, investigate
Never write to the production notes file
Measure the latency of each call and report it
Make the panel show the list at the top
Add tests in the existing style
Open a PR against master when done
Show declined items struck through
It should refresh live when the file changes
メモのパネルにタスク一覧を表示してほしい
ドキュメントも書いてください

PR 9 and PR 10 are merged.
The captain's notes file is hand-edited.
An objective can be of status:
The build takes about two minutes on my laptop.
I was in a meeting this morning.
Thanks, that looks nice.
This is just background for later.
The old layout used # Initial Prompt.
Laya is a local classifier.
The branch is called fm/notes-todo.
We talked about this yesterday.
The file has four headings.
It was working on Friday.
今日は天気がいいですね
これは背景の説明です
Statuses are todo, in progress, done and declined.
My laptop is an M3.
The panel is owned by another worker.
Note: the weights download once.
